notes.content:

notes.title: Early Access Release Date, New Demo and Video
notes.content:
In Hollywood Animal, you'll take the lead of your own film studio, and carve out a place for yourself under the bright Californian sun. But it won't be enough to just place buildings, and hire people, and come up with stories to make into films. After all, you're not the only dreamer in this town. And this time, your competitors aren't the background abstractions you might be expecting in this genre. No, these rivals are cunning, insidious, and willing to cross any line. You'll find out about all it – and much more – in the new gameplay video.


[previewyoutube=oDFPTtGHyno;full][/previewyoutube]

Put your skills to the test on January 16, 2025, when Hollywood Animal goes live on Steam Early Access. And in case you want to practice a little, before your full-on clash with the Hollywood heavyweights, we have prepared a new free demo for you, coming in December.

Wishlist and follow!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2680550/Hollywood_Animal/

- Weappy Wholesome

notes.title: Trading Cards and big balance update now available!
notes.content:

Your THQ Nordic Team

notes.title: Big Balance Improvements: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31927508/dd6571edb078118e33b1101ddc81dbc221783fb6.png[/img]
Hey guys!
Thank you all so much for your feedback. We’re working hard to address all the issues and to make the game more fun to play. In this update we’ve made a lot of balance improvements, we hope you’ll enjoy them. 
[list]
[*]You get rewarded more for arresting criminals and punished less for missing them. 
[*]Professionalism requirements are lower for all missions now
[*]You starting team of cops is much better now
[*]Your cops don’t lose stamina points just for coming in to work, only for actually doing something
[*]Your cops fully recover their stamina after a day off
[*]Your cops don’t lose stamina points for responding to false alarms
[*]Tab prices for cops and equipments are revised
[*]Your cops don’t come up with excuses and stay home as often as they used to
[*]Your cops don’t drink as much as they used to (weird, right?)
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixes an issue in investigation screen that would result in duplicated frames and block progress
[*]Some fixes to text
[/list]

[h1]Installing the update on macOS:[/h1]
if you are getting an error message while launching the game, you need to remove and reinstall the game. This seems to be an issue caused by Steam client on macOS.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31927508/8d2821f595557905b3944b3a923bc08da037d3ff.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone. We're trying to fix issues people have with the game as soon as possible. Here's the first patch with fixes:

[h1] Patch Notes: [/h1]
[list]
    [*]Fixed a serious bug blocking the gameplay in the first investigation if played on Chinese or Japanese language
    [*]Fixed mouse input on PCs with touchscreen
    [*]Changes to game balance
    [*]Fixed a glitch that would cause double items in storage
    [*]Some fixes to Chinese, Japanese and Korean text rendering, like bigger font for tutorials
[/list]

[h1] Balance Improvements: [/h1]
[list]
[*] Your starting team of cops is better now
[*] Professionalism requirement for calls is lowered for the first week (and for some other portions of the game)
[*] The game punishes you less for escaped offenders, killed civilians and skipped tactical missions
[*] The game rewards you more for closed investigations and destroyed gangs
[/list]
